card.name: Relative clause openers before "it is"
card.fires_on: The word that opens a relative clause ending in "it is", "it is today" or "I am today", such as "that", "what", "it" or "the" after a noun like company, tool or center. Fires in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Relative word before it is
modes.description: A relative word such as that, what or it comes right before "it is" or "it is sometimes portrayed".
modes.example: is not the torturous tool of female oppression<< that>> it is sometimes portrayed as! While

modes.label: The after become or made me
modes.description: The word "the" after become or made me, leading into "best version" or "person I am today".
modes.example: have made me<< the>> person I am today. Because they were

modes.label: Noun phrase before today
modes.description: A word inside a phrase such as "the company it is today" or "the standard we know today".
modes.example: turned it into the world-renowned company<< it>> is today. He died at the young

card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where a phrase like "the thing it is today" or "what it is" is about to come up.
